description: Fixed harness regression tasks for LCAH benchmark v3. Each run uses a fresh fixture copy and deterministic scripted outputs; 20 context-pressure tasks exercise automatic compression with outcome-only verifiers.

tasks.prompt: In the README fixture, replace the placeholder opening sentence with 'This fixture is a locked benchmark workspace.'
tasks.expected_artifact: README.md opening sentence is locked benchmark workspace text
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; text = Path('README.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert 'This fixture is a locked benchmark workspace.' in text"

tasks.prompt: Replace the first README bullet with a sentence that says the benchmark schema and baseline are fixed.
tasks.expected_artifact: README.md contains the schema and baseline note
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; text = Path('README.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert 'schema and baseline are fixed' in text"

tasks.prompt: In sample.txt, replace beta with beta-locked.
tasks.expected_artifact: sample.txt contains beta-locked
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; text = Path('sample.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert 'beta-locked' in text and '\nbeta\n' not in text"

tasks.prompt: In sample.txt, replace gamma with gamma-locked.
tasks.expected_artifact: sample.txt contains gamma-locked
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; text = Path('sample.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert 'gamma-locked' in text"

tasks.prompt: Recover after invalid patch arguments and finish the README patch.
tasks.expected_artifact: README.md reflects recovery after invalid patch args
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; text = Path('README.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert 'recovered after invalid patch args' in text"

tasks.prompt: Reject a path escape attempt and still finish the sample.txt patch.
tasks.expected_artifact: sample.txt reflects recovery after path escape rejection
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; text = Path('sample.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert 'alpha-guarded' in text"

tasks.prompt: Recover after repeated identical reads and still finish the sample.txt patch.
tasks.expected_artifact: sample.txt reflects recovery after repeated identical read rejection
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; text = Path('sample.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert 'repeat-guarded' in text"

tasks.prompt: Finish the README update after prompt compression creates a checkpoint.
tasks.expected_artifact: README.md remains available while context reduction creates a checkpoint
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; text = Path('README.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert text.startswith('# Bench Repo README')"

tasks.prompt: Resume the stale benchmark task and finish without trusting the old summary.
tasks.expected_artifact: sample.txt exists after stale freshness recovery
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; text = Path('sample.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert 'stale-updated' in text"

tasks.prompt: Resume after benchmark workspace drift and rebuild runtime state.
tasks.expected_artifact: README.md exists after workspace mismatch recovery
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; assert Path('README.md').is_file()"

tasks.prompt: Capture the stable benchmark facts as durable memory and respond with only the promoted facts.
tasks.expected_artifact: README.md fixture stays available while durable promotion succeeds
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; report = json.loads(next(Path('.lcah/runs').glob('*/report.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8')); conventions = Path('.lcah/memory/topics/project-conventions.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert len(report['durable_promotions']) == 2; assert 'Preserve benchmark regression artifacts under artifacts/.' in conventions"

tasks.prompt: Capture only the stable benchmark facts into durable memory and reject anything transient or secret-shaped.
tasks.expected_artifact: README.md fixture stays available while durable rejection is recorded
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; report = json.loads(next(Path('.lcah/runs').glob('*/report.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8')); assert report['durable_rejections'] == ['dependency-facts:secret_shaped', 'key-decisions:transient_task_state']; assert report['durable_promotions'] == ['project-conventions: Keep verifier outcomes stable across reruns.']"
